sections.label: Expected rise in annual deaths
sections.summary: Annual deaths in Singapore are expected to rise from about 25,000 today to about 60,000 by the 2060s.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Annual deaths in Singapore are expected to increase, from about 25,000 today to about 60,000 by the 2060s.

sections.label: Demand for IAS and new facility
sections.summary: IAS applications rose from about 900 in 2021 to about 2,000 in 2023, and a second IAS facility opens in 2025.

sentences.text: Since its introduction, there has been increasing demand for IAS, with the number of applications increasing steadily from about 900 in 2021 to about 2,000 in 2023.
A second IAS facility, the Garden of Serenity, is being constructed together with the new Mandai Crematorium Complex, which will make IAS more accessible when it is opened in 2025.

sections.label: My Legacy@LifeSG portal launch
sections.summary: My Legacy@LifeSG was launched in 2020 as a one-stop portal on end-of-life planning and post-death matters.

sentences.text: To create awareness and make it easier for individuals to plan ahead, My Legacy@LifeSG was launched in 2020 as a one-stop portal on end-of-life planning and post-death matters.

sections.label: Safeguarding after-death facility sites
sections.summary: MSE and NEA work with MND and URA to safeguard sites for after-death facilities in the medium and long term.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment (MSE) and NEA work closely with the Ministry of National Development (MND) and URA to safeguard sites for the development of after-death facilities in the medium and long term.

sections.label: Government after-death facilities simple and secular
sections.summary: Government after-death facilities are intended to be simple and secular, and their services are cheaper than those of other providers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: In particular, the after-death facilities that are provided by the Government are also intended to be simple and secular to serve the needs of all Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The services provided at these facilities are also much cheaper than those provided by other providers which are mostly affiliated to places of worship or privately owned commercial entities.

sections.label: Affordable remembrance services and facilities
sections.summary: The Government will look at turning ashes into diamonds or other keepsakes, but such services must be affordable for most Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: These are things that we will need to look at and how to turn ashes into diamonds or other things that people can keep for remembrance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: But as I have said, when the Government looks at providing such services or facilities, we have to make them affordable for most, if not all Singaporeans.
